description: Single storey rear extension; front porch; external alterations
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed single rear extension, by reason of its excessive cumulative depth and by reason of its siting, would be detrimental to the amenities of the neighbouring occupiers at No. 22 Landseer Close, contrary to Policy D3.D(7) of the London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The proposal, by reason of the site being located within an area of land liable to flooding and the lack of a comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment, due to a lack of&nbsp;flood mitigation measures which take into account the depth of flooding, flood maps, drainage details and Permeable paving has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies SI12 and SI13 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM 9 and DM 10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).</p>
